_comment: Locally tracked lui-form materialisation hits inside the requested ranges. Regenerate: tools/const_address_materialization.c
claim: This is an encoding census of locally tracked lui plus addiu/ori or displacement forms. It is not a complete pointer-birth or access census.
correction_history: An earlier claim said a missing hit meant the address could not be reached deliberately and any access was incidental. That was wrong because reloads, aliases, calls, CFG joins, and unmodelled register definitions are outside this scanner.
scope: Whole text scanned linearly, so the 46 KB omitted by the function census is examined. Register state is not reset at function boundaries, CFG merges are not modelled, and only selected clobbers are handled. Pointers stored to memory and reloaded elsewhere are not chased.
